* Lookout, South Dakota Division of Wildland Fire. One mile north of Spearfish, SD. Timber and grass. 
Moderate fire behavior with smoldering, backing and creeping. Numerous residences threatened. Evacuations 
and road closures in effect. 
 
* Moonshine, High Desert District, BLM. Seventeen miles southwest of Wheatland, WY. Timber and brush. 
Active fire behavior with running and torching. Residences threatened. 
 
Needles, Pine Ridge Agency, BIA. Two miles east of Evergreen Community, SD. Grass, brush and timber. 
Moderate fire behavior. 
 
Willow, Pike and San Isabel NF, USFS. Six miles west of Leadville, CO. Brush, closed timber litter and timber. 
Minimal fire behavior. 
 
Elk, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. Seven miles northwest of Lake City, CO. Grass 
and timber. No new information. 
 
Aspen Acres, Custer County. Twenty miles southwest of Pueblo, CO. Timber. No new information.
